extracted.description: Enjoy this delicate gin cocktail with a balance of sweet and herbal flavours thanks to rose vermouth and pink lemonade. Best enjoyed on summer afternoons
ingredient_lines: edible rose petals or red berries to garnish
instruction_lines: Fill a highball glass with ice. Pour in the gin, vermouth and rose petal liqueur.
Top up with the pink lemonade, then garnish with edible rose petals or a handful of red berries.
